0.9.135.title: Compass Beta 0.9.135
0.9.135.intro: A redesigned Windows installer: one clean screen, clearer choices, and the Compass icon throughout. You will see it the next time you install or repair Compass; updating from inside the app keeps working as before.

sections.heading: New installer
items: Rebuilt the Windows installer around a single screen: tick the terms, press Install, and Compass is set up for your account with no administrator rights.
Added Customize installation to pick the install folder, create a desktop shortcut and launch Compass when setup finishes.
Added a What's new panel with beta and stable release notes inside the installer.
The installer follows your Windows language, with a menu to switch between English, Português, Русский and العربية.
Update, Repair and Downgrade are detected automatically when Compass is already installed.

sections.heading: Reliability
items: A failed install now explains what went wrong, offers Retry, and lets you copy the details for a bug report.
Closing the window while files are being written is blocked, so an install can no longer be left half finished.
A desktop shortcut is now created by default; you can turn it off in Customize installation.

sections.heading: Look
items: The installer, its window and the uninstaller now use the Compass icon instead of the old boat.
The installer's own interface is about 3 MB lighter.
